NEON RELAY 3 ver1.5 -- licence

The author, SimK, states on the download page
https://simk98.github.io/np21w/download.html (retrieved 2026-10-08):

  下記プログラムの権利主張をする気はありませんが、何らかの表示がないと困る場合の
  ために修正BSDライセンス（NEON RELAY 4のねこアイコン以外は二条項BSDライセンスで
  も可）としておきます。

  (The author does not intend to assert rights in the programs below, but,
  for cases where some notice is needed, places them under the modified
  (3-clause) BSD licence; except for the NEON RELAY 4 cat icon, the
  2-clause BSD licence may also be used.)

NEON RELAY 3 ver1.5 is one of those programs. The modified BSD licence:
